title: Boolean syntax state transition
statement: For a state $q\in\{0,1,2,3,4,5\}$ and a Boolean $b$, define the next state as follows: from state $0$ it is $1$ if $b$ is true and $4$ otherwise; from state $1$ it is $2$ if $b$ is true and $0$ otherwise; from state $2$ it is $2$ if $b$ is true and $3$ otherwise; from state $3$ it is $1$, and from either state $4$ or $5$ it is $5$.
